analysis:
Examined all supplied workflow excerpts, patches, documentation and file metadata. No concrete security regression is established in this scope. ci.yml:664-705, 867-901 and 1003-1157 introduce Git-cache restore/validation/save sequences and disable checkout credential persistence. The supplied SAVE_CACHES expression restricts saves to master/dev pushes; no adversarial cache-write prerequisite is established. Connectivity fsck checks object consistency, not authenticity or safety of cached configuration/hooks, so integration should verify cache producer isolation and the routing/cache-service contract rather than treat fsck as a security boundary.
component-changes.yml:12-13,28 forwards a new mimo_audio classifier output without expanding permissions. Integration must check scripts/ci-component-paths.py and its audio-gate consumer for complete security-relevant input selection. docs-impact.yml:61-68 adds blobless sparse checkout while preserving the signature check and documentation-validation steps; confirm scripts/docs-impact-check.py does not silently omit required provenance checks when excluded evidence/media paths are absent.
ci.yml:912-969 changes cluster-cache identity/save behavior and invokes provider-release-cache.py for timestamps; verify that implementation and provider-ci-build/action.yml bind cached products to changed source, toolchain and dependency pins. Provider Tests at 1169-1201 still explicitly requires selected lanes to succeed; nonblocking GPU behavior is outside the changed ranges. Build documentation and changelog describe tool-cache reuse and push routing, but do not prove their implementations.
Relevant contracts include artifact integrity (A-011/A-017, T-013/T-054), inference correctness and availability (TB-007, A-018), and prefix-cache isolation tests (T-041). This scope does not change live authorization, encryption, billing or prompt storage. Remaining questions concern the related PR implementations, not inferred vulnerabilities in unchanged dependencies.
